title: Sky Awani Residence 5: an affordable home built to make a statement.
videoTitle: PROPERTY REVIEW #406 | SKY AWANI RESIDENCE 5, SENTUL
excerpt: A Rumawip project of about 600 units in Sentul whose glass lobby, facilities and layouts could pass for a RM600,000 project. Sean is amazed by the quality, though cost shows in the details and the location is congested.
takeaways: An 800 sq ft three-plus-one bedroom sells for about RM330,000 on the subsale market.
Partly furnished units rent for about RM2,000, fully furnished up to about RM2,300 to RM2,500.
Every bedroom has a facade window, but the living room is narrow and the roads outside are jammed.

sections.heading: What sets it apart
paragraphs: Sky Awani Residence 5 is a Rumawip project of about 600 units on 2 acres, two blocks joined by a fire escape so they need less separation. Each floor has 12 units, eight on one side and four on a single-loaded side, served by three lifts. It has a fully glazed lobby, a parcel collection area, a covered playground, a pool deck with an almost infinity edge, a semi-open bathroom block, an equipped gym, a reading and meeting room, a games room, a basketball court and a two-storey pavilion on a lawn.

Sean viewed an 800 sq ft three-plus-one Type A: a utility room off the foyer, a large L-shaped kitchen with a yard, a 2.6 m-wide living room, and bedrooms that all have facade windows, the smallest on two sides. Cost shows in the small windows, single sockets, light doors and untinted glass.

sections.heading: Where it is
paragraphs: The project sits on the older side of Sentul among village houses and newer high-rises such as M Arisa and Vox, near a row of schools along Jalan Sentul Pasar. Jalan Kuching and the DUKE highway link it to the city, avoiding the school-time jams on the main road, which is controlled by traffic lights. The roads around it are narrow and lined with parked cars.

sections.heading: Rent and returns
paragraphs: Listings show subsale prices of about RM330,000; Sean thinks owners paid around RM280,000. Partly furnished units rent for about RM2,000 and fully furnished ones up to about RM2,300 to RM2,500, though Sean would be unhappy to see units meant for those in need bought to rent out.

standout.title: Every bedroom gets a real window
standout.body: Instead of bedrooms that only look into an internal void, every room in the layout opens to the outside facade, and the smallest bedroom has windows on two sides. Sean says many open-market projects don't manage this, and it means fresh air and privacy from the corridor.

pros: The intent: it doesn't feel built for compliance but to impress or make a statement, with build quality, design, specs and infrastructure that are superb value for money.

The result: a branded facade, a lawn and basketball court at the entrance, a glass lobby, parcel lockers, good privacy on each floor, a 3+1 layout with a utility room and yard, and facilities that make him question what a RM500,000 project adds.
Thoughtfulness: an open setback from the busy junction, separate walkway lighting, landscaped boundary walls, a transfer structure for a clear facility deck, and well-kept maintenance.
cons: The surroundings: a busy traffic-light junction, narrow village roads made narrower by parked cars, and neighbouring buildings encroaching on setbacks.
It is still cost-driven: dense floor plates, small windows, a narrow living room, few sockets and light doors, which only an industry insider might notice.
Supply: many new projects are chasing Sentul's value and connectivity, adding to the schools, market and places of worship that already jam the roads.

closing: Proof that good design needn't cost much; an outstanding affordable home for the buyers it was meant for.
sourceNote: Based on Sean's full English captions for this October 2025 episode and its video description. The 3 on 3 follows the three things he likes and the three he doesn't, in his order, at the end of the video. An owner let Sean view the unit after completion; prices and rents are from listings as he quoted them, and the purchase price is his guess. Rumawip eligibility, resale and rental rules vary, so check them before buying.
